observed_failure.result: No door had ever denied the network, and no answer was graded. All 728 local-run rows of the last seven days on main carried one rented session's id, so the query rows read a rehearsal. The walk's own rows never reached main. The planner never verified a real option: near misses of 20 of 27 cases collapsed to a band reading 0 of 1. Seven scripted wrong plans verified on the first gradient. An ordinary enquiry never reached S1, and a nested key left every current Codex rollout unread by the share meter.
observed_failure.cause: The doors measured what crossed them, not who asked or whether it was right; a witness with one conjunction gave the ladder no gradient; ranking read file names. Each repaired at cause in the PRs named.
